images.filename: Photograph of President Gerald Ford, First Lady Betty Ford, and President and Mrs. Valery Giscard d'Estaing Posing at... - NARA - 186830.tif
images.caption: This photograph depicts President and Mrs. Ford with French President and Mrs. Valery Giscard d'Estaing standing (center), dressed in formal attire and flanked by a military honor guard. The Grand Staircase of the North Entrance Hall is in the background. This photograph was taken prior to proceeding to the State Dinner held in honor of the French Head of State.
